description: This file defines a 'Home' component for a LightningJS-based web UI. It imports other components, sets up a component with a template layout, manages internal state (positions, rotations, colors), and implements lifecycle hooks and methods for animations and interactions.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A LightningJS component representing the homepage with animations, layout, and footer button.

methods.name: rotateColors
methods.description: Cycles through predefined colors array, updating the 'color' property at specified intervals to animate color change.
